title: 高频动词短语
description: 最常用的短语动词与动词搭配，按真实语料中的出现频率排序：从 take care of、find out 到 come up with、turn out to be。

entries.example: Seen from the sky, the river looked like a huge snake.
entries.translation: 从空中俯瞰，这条河像一条巨蛇。

entries.example: We were just talking about you when you called.
entries.translation: 你打电话来的时候，我们正在谈论你。

entries.example: Please wait for me at the entrance of the building.
entries.translation: 请在大楼入口处等我。

entries.example: They looked at the rubbish, then they looked at each other.
entries.translation: 他们看了看那堆垃圾，然后互相看了一眼。

entries.example: We spent a lot of time looking for a parking lot.
entries.translation: 我们花了很多时间找停车场。

entries.example: He went on reading the book as if nothing had happened.
entries.translation: 他继续读书，好像什么事也没有发生。

entries.example: I always enjoy listening to classical music when I have some free time.
entries.translation: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。

entries.example: My uncle went to Mexico in 1983 and never came back.
entries.translation: 我叔叔1983年去了墨西哥，再也没回来过。

entries.example: Are you seriously thinking about getting married again at your age?
entries.translation: 你真的在考虑你这把年纪还再婚吗？

entries.example: It was raining heavily, so we decided to stay in and watch a movie.
entries.translation: 雨下得很大，所以我们决定待在家里看电影。

entries.example: You'll get into trouble if your girlfriend finds out the truth.
entries.translation: 如果你女朋友发现真相的话，你会有麻烦的。

entries.example: You should take care when crossing the busy street.
entries.translation: 过这条繁忙的街道时，你应该小心。

entries.example: Who will take care of the dog while we are away?
entries.translation: 我们不在的时候谁来照顾狗？

entries.example: This is the house in which I was born and brought up.
entries.translation: 这就是我出生长大的房子。

entries.example: She put her coat on and went out into the cold.
entries.translation: 她穿上外套，走到寒冷的户外。

entries.example: Every time I see you, I think of your mother.
entries.translation: 每次见到你，我都会想起你的母亲。

entries.example: Life is too short to worry about things like that.
entries.translation: 人生太短暂，不值得为那种事情担心。

entries.example: We've got to do something about this problem soon.
entries.translation: 我们得尽快对这个问题采取行动。

entries.example: 80% of all English words come from other languages.
entries.translation: 所有英语单词中有80%来自其他语言。

entries.example: After I got married, my Japanese got better and I could understand more.
entries.translation: 我结婚之后，日语水平提高了，能理解更多了。

entries.example: My father had already finished breakfast when I got up this morning.
entries.translation: 今天早上我起床时，父亲已经吃完早饭了。

entries.example: Are you sure you don't want me to go with you?
entries.translation: 你确定不要我跟你一起去吗？

entries.example: He went back to the dorm as soon as he finished class.
entries.translation: 他一上完课就回宿舍了。

entries.example: I'm surprised you agreed to have lunch with me.
entries.translation: 我很惊讶你同意和我一起吃午饭。

entries.example: Suppose you had a thousand dollars, what would you do with it?
entries.translation: 假如你有一千美元，你会拿它做什么？

entries.example: He tried to give up smoking last year, but it was in vain.
entries.translation: 他去年试着戒烟，但没有成功。

entries.example: If you can't come, you should let me know ahead of time.
entries.translation: 如果你不能来，应该提前告诉我。

entries.example: You need to get out of your comfort zone.
entries.translation: 你需要走出自己的舒适区。

entries.example: We didn't know how to do it, so we asked for help.
entries.translation: 我们不知道怎么做，所以就去求助了。

entries.example: Before now I had no idea that you could cook so well.
entries.translation: 以前我一点都不知道你做饭这么好吃。

entries.example: Thank you for inviting me to the party.
entries.translation: 感谢你邀请我来参加派对。

entries.example: Father makes sure that all the lights are off before he goes to bed.
entries.translation: 父亲睡觉前会确认所有的灯都关好了。

entries.example: When I woke up this morning, I felt a little ill.
entries.translation: 我今天早上醒来时，感觉有点不舒服。

entries.example: I was born in Osaka, but I grew up in Tokyo.
entries.translation: 我出生在大阪，但在东京长大。

entries.example: When did you get back from your trip?
entries.translation: 你什么时候旅游回来的？

entries.example: It is stupid of you to believe in him.
entries.translation: 你相信他真是太愚蠢了。

entries.example: The boy put on his athletic shoes and ran outside.
entries.translation: 那个男孩穿上运动鞋，跑到外面去了。

entries.example: Your sneakers are dirty; take them off before you come in.
entries.translation: 你的运动鞋很脏，进来之前把它们脱掉。

entries.example: She has been working on her thesis for several months.
entries.translation: 她几个月来一直在写她的论文。

entries.example: The train got in ten minutes late because of the snow.
entries.translation: 由于下雪，火车晚点十分钟到达。

entries.example: "How much did you pay for this?" "About 20 euros." "Wow! That's incredibly cheap."
entries.translation: “你为这个付了多少钱？”“大概二十欧元。”“哇！真便宜。”

entries.example: She came out of the bathroom with a towel wrapped around her.
entries.translation: 她裹着浴巾从浴室里走了出来。

entries.example: They were lucky the game went into extra time because they ended up winning.
entries.translation: 他们很幸运比赛进入加时赛，因为他们最终获胜。

entries.example: You'll get into trouble if your girlfriend finds out the truth.
entries.translation: 如果你女朋友发现真相，你会有麻烦的。

entries.example: The plane was about to take off when I heard a strange sound.
entries.translation: 飞机快要起飞的时候，我听到了一个奇怪的声音。

entries.example: I'm sorry I don't agree with you on that matter.
entries.translation: 很抱歉，在那件事上我不同意你的看法。

entries.example: He may well be proud of his sons.
entries.translation: 他完全可以为他的儿子们感到骄傲。

entries.example: I took my shoes off and put them under the bed.
entries.translation: 我把鞋脱了，然后把它们放在床下。

entries.example: I was very tired, so I fell asleep right away.
entries.translation: 我很累，所以马上就睡着了。

entries.example: This bike belongs to my younger brother.
entries.translation: 这辆自行车是我弟弟的。

entries.example: Beethoven went over to the piano, sat down and began to play.
entries.translation: 贝多芬走向钢琴，坐下来开始弹奏。

entries.example: Tom and Jane quarreled, but they made up the next morning.
entries.translation: 汤姆和简吵了一架，但第二天早上就和好了。

entries.example: You can talk to him in plain English and he still won't get it.
entries.translation: 就算你用最浅显的英语跟他说，他还是不明白。

entries.example: My manager stared at me as if he was angry.
entries.translation: 经理盯着我，好像生气了。

entries.example: Can I pick my ticket up at the airport?
entries.translation: 我能在机场领取机票吗？

entries.example: I don't think my father is willing to lend us the car.
entries.translation: 我觉得父亲不愿意把车借给我们。

entries.example: Two men are trying to figure out what's wrong with the car.
entries.translation: 两个男人正试图弄清楚汽车出了什么故障。

entries.example: He's getting along well with all of his classmates.
entries.translation: 他和所有同学都相处融洽。

entries.example: Don't be afraid of making mistakes when you speak English.
entries.translation: 说英语时不要害怕犯错。

entries.example: To tell the truth, I would rather stay at home than go out.
entries.translation: 说实话，我宁愿待在家里也不想出去。

entries.example: My correction fluid has run out, so now I only write in pencil.
entries.translation: 我的涂改液用完了，所以现在只用铅笔写字。

entries.example: Whether he studies or goes into business, I won't stop him.
entries.translation: 不管他是继续读书还是去经商，我都不会阻止他。

entries.example: Did you have fun at the party yesterday?
entries.translation: 昨天聚会你们玩得开心吗？

entries.example: We waited a long time, but she didn't show up.
entries.translation: 我们等了很久，但她还是没有出现。

entries.example: A man came over and asked if I was OK.
entries.translation: 一个男人走过来，问我是否还好。

entries.surface: help my brother with his homework
entries.example: I promised to help my brother with his homework.
entries.translation: 我答应帮弟弟做作业。

entries.example: You have to get on that bus to go to the museum.
entries.translation: 要去博物馆，你得乘坐那辆公交车。

entries.example: His life was full of ups and downs.
entries.translation: 他的人生充满了起起落落。

entries.example: I don't care about sounding natural. I just want to be understood.
entries.translation: 我不在乎是否听起来自然，别人能理解就好。

entries.example: Make sure to turn off all the lights before going out.
entries.translation: 出门前一定要把所有灯都关掉。

entries.example: As soon as he saw a policeman, he ran away.
entries.translation: 他一看见警察就逃走了。

entries.example: Come on, we'll be late if you don't hurry up.
entries.translation: 快点，你再不抓紧我们就要迟到了。

entries.example: I don't like the way you laugh at her.
entries.translation: 我不喜欢你嘲笑她的方式。

entries.example: It sounds like they're not going to leave.
entries.translation: 听着好像他们不打算走。

entries.example: The train will probably arrive at the station before noon.
entries.translation: 火车大概会在中午前到站。

entries.example: The prince fell in love with a woodcutter's daughter.
entries.translation: 王子爱上了一个樵夫的女儿。

entries.example: After losing his job, he went through a very difficult time.
entries.translation: 失业后，他经历了一段非常艰难的时期。

entries.example: We are all looking forward to seeing you and your family.
entries.translation: 我们都期待见到你和你的家人。

entries.example: If small mistakes are not corrected at once, they may lead to serious problems.
entries.translation: 如果小错误不立即纠正，可能会导致严重问题。

entries.example: Don't get off the train till it stops.
entries.translation: 火车停稳前不要下车。

entries.example: I was busy packing, because I was leaving for France in two days.
entries.translation: 我当时正忙着收拾行李，因为我两天后要动身去法国。

entries.example: I was late for school on account of an accident.
entries.translation: 因为一场事故，我上学迟到了。

entries.example: I depend on the alarm clock to wake up on time every morning.
entries.translation: 每天早上我都要靠闹钟来按时叫醒我。

entries.example: I'll do my best not to disturb your studying.
entries.translation: 我会尽量不打扰你复习。

entries.example: After she had lunch, she got ready to go out.
entries.translation: 吃过午饭后，她准备好出门了。

entries.example: He is good at solving complicated mathematical problems.
entries.translation: 他擅长解答复杂的数学难题。

entries.example: I put the book down and turned on the light.
entries.translation: 我把书放下，然后打开了灯。

entries.example: I get dizzy spells when I stand up.
entries.translation: 我一站起来就觉得头晕。

entries.example: I didn't pay attention to what they were saying.
entries.translation: 我没有注意他们在说什么。

entries.example: Did you have a good time on your trip to London?
entries.translation: 你在伦敦旅行玩得开心吗？

entries.example: The patient got better little by little.
entries.translation: 病人逐渐康复了。

entries.example: He went away without saying a word.
entries.translation: 他一句话没说就离开了。

entries.example: His company was set up in 2005.
entries.translation: 他的公司成立于2005年。

entries.example: The unemployment rate went up to 5% because of the recession.
entries.translation: 由于经济衰退，失业率上升到了5%。

entries.example: I'll look after your child while you are away.
entries.translation: 你不在的时候我会照看你的孩子。

entries.example: He apologized to the teacher for coming to school late.
entries.translation: 他因为上学迟到向老师道了歉。

entries.example: My train left at 7 and arrived in New York at 10.
entries.translation: 我乘的火车7点出发，10点到了纽约。

entries.example: The police have been searching for the stolen goods for almost a month.
entries.translation: 警察寻找被盗物品已经快一个月了。

entries.example: My father took out his wallet and gave me ten dollars.
entries.translation: 我爸爸拿出钱包，给了我十美元。

entries.example: I have not heard from her for a month.
entries.translation: 我已经有一个月没她的消息了。

entries.example: The Olympic Games take place at intervals of four years.
entries.translation: 奥运会每四年举行一次。

entries.example: He is moody and difficult to get along with.
entries.translation: 他喜怒无常，极难相处。

entries.example: When writing English, she rarely makes a mistake.
entries.translation: 她写英语时很少犯错误。

entries.example: I spent the whole day cleaning up the room.
entries.translation: 我花了一整天打扫房间。

entries.example: Don't forget to turn off the TV before you go to sleep.
entries.translation: 别忘了睡觉前关掉电视。

entries.example: I've just spoken to your French teacher and he says you're doing well in his class.
entries.translation: 我刚跟你的法语老师谈过，他说你在他的课上表现很好。

entries.example: If you look around, you'll see many people doing the same thing.
entries.translation: 看看四周，你会看到很多人在做同样的事情。

entries.example: I got lost, and to make it even worse, it then began to rain.
entries.translation: 我迷了路，更糟的是，天开始下雨了。

entries.example: It's getting dark. Please turn the light on for me.
entries.translation: 天快黑了。请帮我开灯。

entries.example: I am used to hearing the train pass by my house.
entries.translation: 我已经习惯了听见火车经过我家门口。

entries.example: It's rude to make fun of your boss in public.
entries.translation: 在公开场合取笑你的老板是很无礼的。

entries.example: I'm sorry to hear that your father passed away.
entries.translation: 听到你父亲去世的消息，我很难过。

entries.example: Our conclusion is based on previous studies of the problem.
entries.translation: 我们的结论基于之前对这个问题的研究。

entries.example: My brother would often stay up all night reading novels.
entries.translation: 我哥哥经常熬夜看小说。

entries.example: When have you got to hand in your essay?
entries.translation: 你什么时候需要交作文？

entries.example: I got hurt during an experiment, and the injury was pretty serious.
entries.translation: 我在做实验时受了伤，而且伤得相当严重。

entries.example: Ziri put up hooks for gardening tools in the garage.
entries.translation: 齐里在车库里装上了用来挂园艺工具的挂钩。

entries.example: You are welcome to join us.
entries.translation: 欢迎你加入我们。

entries.example: Private detectives were hired to look into the strange case.
entries.translation: 私家侦探们受雇调查这桩离奇的案件。

entries.example: Look out! There's a hole in the road.
entries.translation: 小心！路上有个洞。

entries.example: If you like, I will teach you to play chess.
entries.translation: 你要是想学的话，我可以教你下棋。

entries.example: Let's forget about what happened today.
entries.translation: 咱们忘了今天发生的事吧。

entries.example: It was five years ago that I graduated from college.
entries.translation: 我大学毕业是五年前的事。

entries.example: Don't be afraid of making mistakes when you speak English.
entries.translation: 说英语时不要害怕犯错。

entries.example: It's my custom to go for a walk before breakfast.
entries.translation: 我习惯在早饭前出去散步。

entries.example: These garments are made of 100 percent wool.
entries.translation: 这些衣服是用百分百羊毛制成的。

entries.example: She seems to be in love with my brother.
entries.translation: 她似乎爱上了我哥哥。

entries.example: He should apologize for being rude to the guests.
entries.translation: 他应该为自己对客人的粗鲁无礼而道歉。

entries.example: The best way to lose weight is to eat less and exercise more.
entries.translation: 最好的减肥方法就是少吃多运动。

entries.example: You should pay attention to what he says.
entries.translation: 你得注意他说的话。

entries.example: I've written an article. Could you take a look and tell me if it's okay?
entries.translation: 我写了一篇文章，你能不能看一下，告诉我行不行？

entries.example: Sometimes things that happen do not make sense.
entries.translation: 有时候，发生的事情并不合情合理。

entries.example: Six people applied for the job, but none of them were employed.
entries.translation: 有六个人申请了这份工作，但一个也没被录用。

entries.example: Everyone would like to believe that dreams can come true.
entries.translation: 人人都愿意相信美梦可以成真。

entries.example: To be honest, I've never heard of this place before.
entries.translation: 说实话，我以前没听说过这个地方。

entries.example: They went ahead with their plan.
entries.translation: 他们继续推行他们的计划。

entries.example: I would often take part in an English speech contest in my school days.
entries.translation: 当年我在学校的时候经常参加英语演讲比赛。

entries.example: Calm down, and listen to me speak from the beginning.
entries.translation: 冷静下来，从头开始听我说。

entries.example: We used to go to the movies on Saturday evening.
entries.translation: 我们以前常在星期六傍晚去看电影。

entries.example: I take a walk every day except when it rains.
entries.translation: 除了下雨天，我每天都散步。

entries.example: I'll use it a bit this evening, and try my best to give it back to you tomorrow.
entries.translation: 今天晚上我先用一下，争取明天还给你。

entries.example: As soon as she finished, she lay down and had a nap.
entries.translation: 她一结束就躺下打了个盹儿。

entries.example: The phone rang while I was taking a shower.
entries.translation: 我洗澡的时候，电话响了。

entries.example: In the winter, many older people slip on ice and fall down.
entries.translation: 冬天，许多老人在冰上滑倒。

entries.example: After you have read it, give the book back to me.
entries.translation: 你读完这本书之后，把它还给我。

entries.example: She wants to move out and find a place of her own.
entries.translation: 她想搬出去，找个属于自己的地方。

entries.example: Our plan went wrong from the beginning.
entries.translation: 我们的计划从一开始就出错了。

entries.example: I've done half the work, and now I can take a break.
entries.translation: 我已经做完了一半工作，现在可以休息一下了。

entries.example: The man turned out to be a private detective.
entries.translation: 这个男人竟然是个私家侦探。

entries.example: I am familiar with the author's name.
entries.translation: 我对这位作者的名字很熟悉。

entries.example: Her mind is filled with dreams of becoming an actress.
entries.translation: 她满脑子都是成为演员的梦想。

entries.example: She succeeded in getting him to tell the truth.
entries.translation: 她成功让他说出了真相。

entries.example: Mike eats out almost every night.
entries.translation: 迈克几乎每天晚上都出去吃饭。

entries.example: I don't want to be involved in that matter.
entries.translation: 我不想被牵扯到这件事里。

entries.example: Hurry up, or you will miss the last train.
entries.translation: 快点，否则你会赶不上末班车。

entries.example: Ha - this work's finished! Let's move on to the next stage!
entries.translation: 哈，这个活儿干完了！我们进入下一阶段吧！

entries.example: He still hasn't responded to my letter.
entries.translation: 他还没有回我的信。

entries.example: I always take a bath before going to bed.
entries.translation: 我睡觉前总要洗个澡。

entries.example: My grandfather is fond of taking a walk early in the morning.
entries.translation: 我爷爷喜欢一大早去散步。

entries.example: If you keep on endlessly complaining, I will get angry.
entries.translation: 如果你继续没完没了地抱怨，我就会生气。

entries.example: Mother was busy getting ready for dinner.
entries.translation: 母亲正忙着准备晚餐。

entries.example: This is the house in which I was born and brought up.
entries.translation: 这就是我出生并长大的房子。

entries.example: This district is known for its beautiful scenery.
entries.translation: 这个地区以风景优美而闻名。

entries.example: Hold on a second, I'll be right back. Don't hang up!
entries.translation: 等一下，我马上就回来。不要挂断电话！

entries.example: Be sure to put out the fire before you leave.
entries.translation: 离开前一定要把火熄灭。

entries.example: They consider it impolite to disagree with someone they don't know very well.
entries.translation: 他们认为反驳一个不太熟的人是不礼貌的。

entries.example: I fear this work will take up most of my time.
entries.translation: 我怕这项工作会占用我的大部分时间。

entries.example: It's fun to learn about foreign cultures.
entries.translation: 了解外国文化很有趣。

entries.example: She wrote down that person's name so as not to forget it.
entries.translation: 为了不忘掉，她把那个人的名字写了下来。

entries.example: She turned down the subsidy that I offered.
entries.translation: 她拒绝了我的资助。

entries.example: I can't help feeling sorry for him.
entries.translation: 我不禁为他感到难过。

entries.example: If it’s sold out, then just forget it.
entries.translation: 要是卖完了，就算了。

entries.example: When you are driving, you should slow down on corners.
entries.translation: 开车时，遇到转弯处应该减速。

entries.example: I am tired of my monotonous life.
entries.translation: 我厌倦了单调的生活。

entries.example: Would you take a picture of us with this camera?
entries.translation: 你能用这台相机帮我们拍张照吗？

entries.example: I told her not to let go of the rope, but she did.
entries.translation: 我叫她不要松开绳子，但她还是松开了。

entries.example: I almost stepped on a skunk last night.
entries.translation: 我昨晚差点踩到一只臭鼬。

entries.example: If you want to change the world, then you should start with yourself.
entries.translation: 如果你想改变世界，那就从你自己开始吧。

entries.example: We moved into this house last month, but we still haven't settled down.
entries.translation: 我们上个月搬进了这所房子，但还没有安顿下来。

entries.example: He has only one aim in life, to make money.
entries.translation: 他的人生只有一个目标：赚钱。

entries.example: Don't be scared of making mistakes.
entries.translation: 别害怕犯错。

entries.example: Can I take a look at that jacket?
entries.translation: 可以看一下那件夹克吗？

entries.example: I'd like some time to consider before I make a decision.
entries.translation: 我想花点时间斟酌一下再作决定。

entries.example: She helped her daughter get dressed.
entries.translation: 她帮女儿穿好了衣服。

entries.example: They planned to get together here at 7 o'clock.
entries.translation: 他们计划七点在这里碰头。

entries.example: The tablets took away my pain.
entries.translation: 药片止住了我的疼痛。

entries.example: What did you major in at college?
entries.translation: 你大学时主修什么？

entries.example: He threw away a bunch of old letters.
entries.translation: 他扔掉了一堆旧信件。

entries.example: It's really cold today. You should dress warmer or you might catch a cold.
entries.translation: 今天天气很冷，你多穿点衣服吧，要不然会感冒的。

entries.example: If we get started now, we can finish the report by noon.
entries.translation: 如果我们现在开始，中午之前就能完成报告。

entries.example: It was foolish of her to ask him for help.
entries.translation: 她去找他帮忙，实在不是一个明智之举。

entries.example: Your wife is mad at you.
entries.translation: 你太太在生你的气。

entries.example: He kept me waiting for more than an hour.
entries.translation: 他让我等了一个多小时。

entries.example: We easily figured out the password.
entries.translation: 我们毫不费力地想出了密码。

entries.example: I don't want to be friends with you.
entries.translation: 我不想跟你交朋友。

entries.example: Please leave me alone; I need some time to think.
entries.translation: 请让我一个人待会儿，我需要时间思考。

entries.example: Look in the rear-view mirror before backing up.
entries.translation: 倒车前先看后视镜。

entries.example: The party has been put off until next Tuesday.
entries.translation: 聚会已经推迟到了下周二。

entries.example: If you have a cold, you should get plenty of rest.
entries.translation: 如果你感冒了，应该好好休息。

entries.example: Will you put down that paper and listen to me?
entries.translation: 你能放下那份报纸听我说吗？

entries.example: The student handed the examination papers in to the teacher.
entries.translation: 这名学生把试卷交给了老师。

entries.example: If you don't know what the word means, look it up in the dictionary.
entries.translation: 如果你不知道这个词的意思，就查一下词典。

entries.example: If you take my advice, you'll see a doctor.
entries.translation: 如果你听我的建议，就去看医生。

entries.example: People there decorate their homes with potted flowers to add to the festival atmosphere.
entries.translation: 为了增添节日气氛，那里的人用盆栽装饰自己的家。

entries.example: Hang on, I need to go to the bathroom.
entries.translation: 等一下，我得去趟洗手间。

entries.example: As long as you keep quiet, you can stay here.
entries.translation: 只要你保持安静，你就可以留在这里。

entries.example: The article begins with an account of the current situation.
entries.translation: 文章开头讲了当前的形势。

entries.example: Let's keep going and see the next town.
entries.translation: 我们继续走吧，去看看下一个镇子。

entries.example: Guess what? I finally got the job I wanted.
entries.translation: 猜怎么着？我终于得到了我想要的工作。

entries.example: The climate of Tokyo is different from that of London.
entries.translation: 东京的气候和伦敦不同。

entries.example: He was absent from school yesterday because he was ill.
entries.translation: 他昨天因为生病没去上学。

entries.example: Neither he nor she wants to do the dishes, and so the two of them decided to eat out.
entries.translation: 他和她都不想洗碗，于是两人决定出去吃饭。

entries.example: We all helped with the harvest.
entries.translation: 我们都帮忙收割。

entries.example: Kyoto is famous for its shrines and temples.
entries.translation: 京都以它的神社和寺庙而闻名。

entries.example: It was not long before he got well.
entries.translation: 不久后，他恢复了健康。

entries.example: Please say hello to your family on my behalf.
entries.translation: 请代我向你的家人问好。

entries.example: It was obvious that they had told a lie.
entries.translation: 他们分明说了谎。

entries.example: Bread is made from flour, water, and often yeast.
entries.translation: 面包是由面粉、水，有时还有酵母制成的。

entries.example: We'll wait and see what happens.
entries.translation: 我们要等等看会发生什么。

entries.example: I will call back a bit later.
entries.translation: 我稍后再回电话。

entries.example: You are working too hard. Take it easy for a while.
entries.translation: 你工作得太辛苦了。放松一下。

entries.example: I can't concentrate on my work because of the noise.
entries.translation: 因为噪音，我无法专心工作。

entries.example: Switch off the light. I can't get to sleep.
entries.translation: 把灯关了，我睡不着。

entries.example: It has finally stopped snowing and has warmed up.
entries.translation: 雪终于停了，天气也开始暖和了。

entries.example: It is bad manners to point at people.
entries.translation: 用手指点别人不礼貌。

entries.example: Hurry up and set the table for dinner.
entries.translation: 快点摆好餐具准备吃晚饭。

entries.example: Sue checked in at the Royal Hotel.
entries.translation: 苏在皇家酒店办理了入住登记。

entries.example: I would like to have a look at your collection of stamps.
entries.translation: 我想看看您的邮票收藏。

entries.example: I lost my way and, what was worse, it began to rain.
entries.translation: 我迷了路，更糟的是，天开始下雨了。

entries.example: The couple walked holding hands in the moonlight.
entries.translation: 那对情侣在月光下牵着手散步。

entries.example: The climate of New Zealand is similar to that of Japan.
entries.translation: 新西兰的气候与日本的相似。

entries.example: My hobby is taking pictures of wild flowers.
entries.translation: 我的业余爱好是给野花拍照。

entries.example: We need to fill up at the next gas station.
entries.translation: 我们需要在下一个加油站加油。

entries.example: Can you take notes for me during the professor's talk?
entries.translation: 你能在教授讲座期间替我记笔记吗？

entries.example: Why did you leave out the first question on the exam?
entries.translation: 你为什么漏掉了考试的第一题？

entries.example: We must always be prepared for disasters.
entries.translation: 我们必须始终为灾害做好准备。

entries.example: Would you like to leave a message for him?
entries.translation: 您想给他留个言吗？

entries.example: If you make a study plan, you can make progress efficiently.
entries.translation: 只要制定学习计划，就能有效地取得进步。

entries.example: I competed with him for the championship.
entries.translation: 我和他竞争冠军。

entries.example: Even though we are far apart, we still keep in touch.
entries.translation: 尽管我们相隔很远，我们仍然保持联系。

entries.example: He quickly made friends with the new boy on the block.
entries.translation: 他很快便和街区里新来的男孩交上了朋友。

entries.example: You may only borrow my camera if you are careful with it.
entries.translation: 只有你小心使用，我才会把相机借给你。

entries.example: My son surprised me by tidying up his room without being told.
entries.translation: 我儿子没等别人吩咐就整理了自己的房间，这让我很意外。

entries.example: They waited in line for the bus.
entries.translation: 他们排队等公共汽车。

entries.example: I went on holiday to Scotland this summer.
entries.translation: 今年夏天我去苏格兰度假了。

entries.example: I was having a bath when the telephone rang.
entries.translation: 我正在洗澡的时候电话响了。

entries.example: She got on a bus and took a seat in the front.
entries.translation: 她上了公交车，在前排坐下了。

entries.example: He refused to shake hands with me.
entries.translation: 他拒绝跟我握手。

entries.example: She bent down and picked up the coin.
entries.translation: 她弯下腰，把硬币捡了起来。

entries.example: He told me that he's going on a trip.
entries.translation: 他告诉我他要去旅行。

entries.example: After walking for an hour, we stopped to take a rest.
entries.translation: 走了一个小时后，我们停下来休息。

entries.example: Did you ever make a speech in English?
entries.translation: 你曾经用英语发表过演讲吗？

entries.example: He had a shower before breakfast.
entries.translation: 他在早餐前洗了个澡。

entries.example: I was hot, so I switched on the fan.
entries.translation: 我很热，就把电风扇打开了。

entries.example: She stepped forward to shake his hand.
entries.translation: 她走上前来和他握手。

entries.example: He had to stand in line at the ticket office.
entries.translation: 他不得不在售票处排队。

entries.example: You can't just work all day every day. You need to take a vacation once in a while.
entries.translation: 你不能每天整天只工作。你需要偶尔度个假。

entries.example: Don't make noise when you eat soup.
entries.translation: 喝汤时不要发出声音。

entries.example: She lifted up her head and looked at him.
entries.translation: 她抬起头看着他。

entries.example: Is there a discount if you pay in cash?
entries.translation: 如果用现金付款，有折扣吗？

entries.example: Wait a minute… I think you should go with them.
entries.translation: 等一下……我觉得你应该跟他们一起去。

entries.example: She is on a diet for fear that she will put on weight.
entries.translation: 她因为担心发胖而节食。

entries.example: You will be sorry for it some day.
entries.translation: 总有一天你会为此后悔的。

entries.example: It'd definitely be worth it to expand on your idea.
entries.translation: 详细阐述你的想法肯定是值得的。

entries.example: Children should keep away from the river. It's dangerous.
entries.translation: 孩子们应该远离这条河，那很危险。

entries.example: She can never keep a secret.
entries.translation: 她永远也做不到保守秘密。

entries.example: You need a password to log in again after logging out.
entries.translation: 登出后重新登录需要密码。

entries.example: Once you have made a promise, you should keep it.
entries.translation: 一旦你许下承诺，就应该遵守。

entries.example: Her daughter is bad at cooking.
entries.translation: 她女儿的厨艺很差。

entries.example: We'll have a picnic tomorrow, weather permitting.
entries.translation: 如果天气允许，我们明天会去野餐。

entries.example: Could you do me a favour and call a doctor?
entries.translation: 你能帮我个忙，叫个医生来吗？

entries.example: When do you usually get off work?
entries.translation: 你一般几点下班？

entries.example: He tried to cheer up his wife, but wasn't able to.
entries.translation: 他试图让妻子振作起来，但没能做到。

entries.example: To take a photo, all you need to do is to press this button.
entries.translation: 要拍照，你只需按下这个按钮。

entries.example: Please have a seat and wait until your name is called.
entries.translation: 请坐下，等候叫到您的名字。

entries.example: I'm careful when I zip up my jeans, not to pinch myself.
entries.translation: 我拉牛仔裤拉链时很小心，以免夹到自己。

entries.example: Asbestos is nasty stuff, and it can cause lung cancer if you breathe in the dust.
entries.translation: 石棉是有害物质，如果吸入其粉尘，可能会导致肺癌。

entries.example: Please do not hang up the phone.
entries.translation: 请不要挂断电话。

entries.example: He hopes he'll win and I hope so too.
entries.translation: 他希望自己能赢，我也希望如此。

entries.example: Please pay cash, not by credit card.
entries.translation: 请付现金，不要用信用卡。

entries.example: The girl in a white uniform took my temperature.
entries.translation: 一个穿白色制服的女孩给我量了体温。

entries.example: The ingenious boy won a prize for his invention.
entries.translation: 那个有发明才能的男孩凭借自己的发明得了奖。

entries.example: You must be careful of the traffic when you cross the street.
entries.translation: 你过马路时一定要当心来往车辆。

entries.example: These scissors are suitable for left and right-handed people.
entries.translation: 这些剪刀适合左撇子和右撇子使用。

entries.example: In the U.S., we say "bless you" to someone when they sneeze.
entries.translation: 在美国，有人打喷嚏时我们会说“保佑你”。

entries.example: It appears that she had a nice time at the party.
entries.translation: 看来她在派对上玩得很开心。

entries.example: We had a rest in the shade.
entries.translation: 我们在阴凉处休息了一下。

entries.example: I would like to book a room with a double bed.
entries.translation: 我想预订一间带双人床的房间。

entries.example: If you will excuse me for a few minutes, I'd like to make a call.
entries.translation: 请原谅我离开几分钟，我想打个电话。

entries.example: I knelt down to tie my shoes.
entries.translation: 我跪下来系鞋带。

entries.example: Ben learned to make a fire without matches.
entries.translation: 本学会了不用火柴生火。

entries.example: I have a sore throat and a slight fever.
entries.translation: 我喉咙痛，还有点发烧。

entries.example: I had to make a choice between chocolate and vanilla.
entries.translation: 我不得不在巧克力和香草之间做出选择。

entries.example: My grandfather takes medicine every day.
entries.translation: 我爷爷每天吃药。

entries.example: Everything depends upon your decision.
entries.translation: 一切取决于你的决定。

entries.example: They're having a break at the moment.
entries.translation: 他们现在正在休息。

entries.example: At the next intersection, take a right.
entries.translation: 在下一个路口向右拐。

entries.example: Wait a second. My shoe is untied.
entries.translation: 等一下，我的鞋带松了。

entries.example: Let's go for a ride in my car.
entries.translation: 我们坐我的车去兜风吧。

entries.example: Excuse me, could you please take a photo of my friends and me?
entries.translation: 打扰一下，您能给我和朋友们拍张照片吗？

entries.example: As long as we're all just hanging around chatting, may I make a suggestion? Get back to work!
entries.translation: 既然我们都在这儿闲聊，我能提个建议吗？回去工作吧！

entries.example: You put away the sheets, and I'll make the bed.
entries.translation: 你把床单收起来，我来铺床。

entries.example: I have to take a test tomorrow.
entries.translation: 明天我必须参加考试。

entries.example: You need to open an account at a bank to receive the payment.
entries.translation: 你需要在一家银行开户才能收到这笔款项。

entries.example: Keep it up, and you'll go far.
entries.translation: 继续保持，你会大有前途的。

entries.example: Miss Jones made a face when she heard the news.
entries.translation: 琼斯小姐听到这个消息时做了个鬼脸。

entries.example: It is bad manners to make a noise while you eat.
entries.translation: 吃饭时发出声音是不礼貌的。

entries.example: It's nearly lunchtime. Why don't we stop to have a bite to eat?
entries.translation: 快到午饭时间了，我们为什么不停下来吃点东西呢？

entries.example: Let me have a try at it.
entries.translation: 让我试一下。

entries.example: He never stops to take a breath when he speaks.
entries.translation: 他说话时从不停下来喘口气。

entries.example: Before taking action, make sure you are clear about what the goal is.
entries.translation: 采取行动之前，一定要清楚目标是什么。

entries.example: The worst loneliness is to not be comfortable with yourself.
entries.translation: 最糟糕的孤独就是无法自在地接纳自己。

entries.example: Many people take an interest in cars, but they don't interest me at all.
entries.translation: 许多人对汽车感兴趣，可我对汽车毫无兴趣。

entries.example: I keep fit by jogging every morning.
entries.translation: 我每天早晨慢跑来保持健康。

entries.example: He pressed down on the suitcase to close it.
entries.translation: 他用力按压行李箱好把它合上。

entries.example: The bigger kids pushed him over and ran off before the teacher came.
entries.translation: 大一点的孩子把他推倒，然后在老师来之前跑掉了。

entries.example: You have nothing to be sorry about.
entries.translation: 你没什么可抱歉的。

entries.example: Did you have a good night last night?
entries.translation: 你昨晚睡得好吗？

entries.example: She likes to make tea for her guests every afternoon.
entries.translation: 她喜欢每天下午为客人沏茶。

entries.example: At the risk of sounding too forward, I'd like to make a comment.
entries.translation: 冒着显得太冒昧的风险，我想发表一点意见。

entries.example: When you breathe out in cold weather, you can see your breath.
entries.translation: 在寒冷的天气里呼气时，你能看到自己呼出的白气。

entries.example: You should have known better than to take an examination without preparing for it.
entries.translation: 你应该知道不准备就去参加考试是不明智的。

entries.example: Do you keep in contact with your high school classmates?
entries.translation: 你还和你的高中同学保持联系吗？

entries.example: She is married to an English teacher, so she can take lessons free of charge.
entries.translation: 她嫁给了一位英语老师，所以能免费上课。

entries.example: After the incident I came to have a higher opinion of him.
entries.translation: 那次事件之后，我逐渐对他有了更高的评价。

entries.example: The child had no overcoat on although it was very cold.
entries.translation: 虽然天气很冷，那个孩子却没有穿外套。

entries.example: The bus had already left when we got to the bus stop.
entries.translation: 我们到达公交车站时，公交车已经开走了。

entries.example: She talked so quickly that I couldn't get a word in.
entries.translation: 她说得太快了，我一句嘴都插不上。

entries.example: I was planning on going to the beach today, but then it started to rain.
entries.translation: 我本来打算今天去海滩，但后来开始下雨了。

entries.example: The washing machine is broken, so we need to get someone in to fix it.
entries.translation: 洗衣机坏了，我们得请人来修一下。

entries.example: As it is very hot today, I don't feel like studying.
entries.translation: 今天太热了，我没心情学习。

entries.example: My dream is to make it as an actor in Hollywood.
entries.translation: 我的梦想是在好莱坞成为一名成功的演员。

entries.example: My mother happened to be there when the fire broke out.
entries.translation: 着火的时候我妈妈恰好在那儿。

entries.example: It took me a moment to take in what she had just said.
entries.translation: 我花了一会儿才明白她刚才说的话。

entries.example: The old couple took in the boy and treated him like their own son.
entries.translation: 这对老夫妇收留了那个男孩，待他像亲生儿子一样。

entries.example: Dark as it was, we managed to find our way home.
entries.translation: 天色很暗，但我们还是找到了回家的路。

entries.example: His intelligence and experience enabled him to deal with the trouble.
entries.translation: 他的智慧和经验使他能够处理这个麻烦。

entries.example: The committee sat on the proposal for weeks before making a decision.
entries.translation: 委员会把这项提案搁置了数周才做出决定。

entries.example: Please let me pick up your sister at the station.
entries.translation: 请让我到车站去接你姐姐。

entries.example: People who play with mud will get their hands dirty.
entries.translation: 玩泥巴的人会弄脏自己的手。

entries.example: People tend to tire of eating the same food every day.
entries.translation: 人们往往会厌倦每天吃同样的食物。

entries.example: The phone call was a trick to get him out of the house.
entries.translation: 那通电话是个把他骗出家门的诡计。

entries.example: Leave it to me, I'll take care of this problem.
entries.translation: 交给我吧，我会处理这个问题。

entries.example: I'll arrange for someone to pick you up at your home.
entries.translation: 我会安排人去你家接你。

entries.example: During my free time I like to hang out with my friends.
entries.translation: 空闲时我喜欢和朋友们一起出去玩。

entries.example: You can have your money back if the product doesn't work as advertised.
entries.translation: 如果产品不像宣传的那样好用，你可以把钱拿回来。

entries.example: Do you think you can live on a dollar a day in America?
entries.translation: 你觉得在美国每天只靠一美元能生活吗？

entries.example: She took to her new school much faster than we had expected.
entries.translation: 她适应新学校的速度比我们预想的快得多。

entries.example: She never forgot the people who had done her wrong.
entries.translation: 她从未忘记那些亏待过她的人。

entries.example: Almost two weeks went by before John recovered from his illness.
entries.translation: 差不多过了两周，约翰的病才痊愈。

entries.example: The roof fell in under the weight of the heavy snow.
entries.translation: 在厚雪的重压下，屋顶塌了。

entries.example: A few days off will do you good.
entries.translation: 休息几天会对你有好处。

entries.example: The long hike yesterday really did me in.
entries.translation: 昨天长途徒步真把我累垮了。

entries.example: I usually sleep in on Saturday mornings because I have no classes.
entries.translation: 我星期六早上通常睡懒觉，因为没课。

entries.example: We had some friends over for dinner last night.
entries.translation: 昨晚我们请了一些朋友来家里吃晚饭。

entries.example: I hope everything will turn out well in the end.
entries.translation: 我希望最后一切都好。

entries.surface: get a single word out of
entries.meaning: 从某人那里问出，探听出
entries.example: However hard I tried, I couldn't get a single word out of him.
entries.translation: 无论我怎么努力，都没能从他嘴里问出一个字。

entries.example: I got a lot out of the writing course I took last summer.
entries.translation: 我从去年夏天参加的写作课程中收获很多。

entries.example: Jim has been trying to take me out to dinner for the last three weeks.
entries.translation: 过去三个星期里，吉姆一直想带我出去吃饭。

entries.example: You must get the job done before the deadline.
entries.translation: 你必须在截止日期前完成这项工作。

entries.example: She discovered that she had run out of salt.
entries.translation: 她发现家里的盐已经用完了。

entries.example: I've had a headache for three days and I can't get rid of it.
entries.translation: 我已经头疼三天了，还是摆脱不了。

entries.example: He sometimes has trouble expressing his opinions.
entries.translation: 他有时难以表达自己的观点。

entries.example: I tried to change her mind, but I couldn't.
entries.translation: 我试图改变她的主意，但没能成功。

entries.example: He is busy preparing for the entrance examination.
entries.translation: 他正忙着准备入学考试。

entries.example: Many people are suffering from hunger around the world.
entries.translation: 世界上许多人正在遭受饥饿。

entries.example: For the time being, I must share this room with my friend.
entries.translation: 眼下我不得不和我朋友同住这个房间。

entries.example: A lot of housewives complain about the high prices of goods.
entries.translation: 许多家庭主妇抱怨物价太高。

entries.example: We didn't have much money, so we had to make do with second-hand furniture.
entries.translation: 我们没多少钱，所以只好将就用二手家具。

entries.example: Last night, I ran into my teacher at the restaurant.
entries.translation: 昨晚我在餐厅里碰见了老师。

entries.example: The accident seemed to have something to do with the heavy snow.
entries.translation: 事故似乎与这场大雪有关。

entries.example: I think that you should break up with your boyfriend.
entries.translation: 我觉得你应该跟男友分手。

entries.example: The sun comes up in the east and goes down in the west.
entries.translation: 太阳从东方升起，在西方落下。

entries.example: She was hesitant to take on extra work because of her health.
entries.translation: 由于健康原因，她不太愿意承担额外的工作。

entries.example: I guess that you heard about what happened this morning.
entries.translation: 我想你听说了今天早上发生的事。

entries.example: Tom has no one to turn to for help.
entries.translation: 汤姆没有可以求助的人。

entries.example: I can't focus on two things at the same time.
entries.translation: 我不能同时专注于两件事。

entries.example: As we went around the corner, the lake came into view.
entries.translation: 当我们转过拐角时，湖映入眼帘。

entries.example: My colleague will stand in for me while I am on vacation.
entries.translation: 我休假时，同事会代替我。

entries.example: He and his wife tried to work out their problems, but couldn't.
entries.translation: 他和妻子试图解决他们的问题，但没能做到。

entries.example: Don't let narrow-minded people convince you that your dreams are too big.
entries.translation: 别让心胸狭隘的人使你相信你的梦想过于宏大。

entries.example: People living in a big city tend to lack exercise.
entries.translation: 住在大城市的人往往缺乏锻炼。

entries.example: They came up with a plan after a long discussion.
entries.translation: 经过漫长的讨论，他们终于想出了一个计划。

entries.example: The young boxer decided to take the champion on.
entries.translation: 这位年轻拳手决定与冠军较量。

entries.example: The company decided to keep her on after the merger.
entries.translation: 合并后公司决定继续雇用她。

entries.example: Just leave me be; I need some time to think.
entries.translation: 别管我，我需要些时间思考。

entries.example: You will soon get used to speaking in public.
entries.translation: 你很快就会习惯在公共场合讲话。

entries.example: I can't remember the meaning of the word that I looked up yesterday.
entries.translation: 我记不起昨天查的那个词的意思了。

entries.example: I'd like to try this on. Where are the fitting rooms?
entries.translation: 我想试穿这件。试衣间在哪里？

entries.example: Several good ideas came out of the discussion we had yesterday.
entries.translation: 我们昨天的讨论产生了好几个好主意。

entries.example: The teacher tried to involve every student in the discussion.
entries.translation: 老师试图让每个学生都参与讨论。

entries.example: I'm discussing something with my friends at the moment. Wait a bit and I'll get back to you.
entries.translation: 我现在正在和朋友讨论一些事情。稍等一下，我会回复你。

entries.example: You can't count on their help.
entries.translation: 你不能指望他们的帮助。

entries.example: He cheated on the biology exam.
entries.translation: 他在生物考试中作弊。

entries.example: The coach really gave it to the players after their careless mistakes.
entries.translation: 球员们犯了粗心的错误后，教练狠狠地训了他们一顿。

entries.example: From childhood I dreamed of being a pastry cook.
entries.translation: 我从小就梦想成为一名糕点师。

entries.example: When you're done with the book, put it back where you found it.
entries.translation: 你看完这本书后，把它放回你原来拿的地方。

entries.example: He's very honest, so we can rely on him.
entries.translation: 他非常诚实，所以我们可以依靠他。

entries.meaning: 帮某人解困，帮某人一把
entries.example: You need to have friends who can help you out.
entries.translation: 你需要有能在困难时帮你的朋友。

entries.example: You shouldn't say that kind of thing when children are around.
entries.translation: 孩子们在旁边的时候，你不该说那种话。

entries.example: He fell into the habit of keeping late hours.
entries.translation: 他养成了熬夜的习惯。

entries.example: She yelled at the children to be quiet.
entries.translation: 她大声叫孩子们安静。

entries.example: It is no use blaming him for the accident now.
entries.translation: 事情已经发生了，现在为这起事故怪他也没有用。

entries.example: My questions were met with a frosty silence.
entries.translation: 我的问题遭到了冷冰冰的沉默。

entries.example: Mastering a foreign language calls for patience.
entries.translation: 掌握一门外语需要耐心。

entries.example: This photograph reminds me of enjoyable times when I was a child.
entries.translation: 这张照片让我想起童年的快乐时光。

entries.example: Some beaches had failed to comply with environmental regulations.
entries.translation: 一些海滩未能遵守环保规定。

entries.example: That man died of lung cancer a week ago.
entries.translation: 那个男人一周前死于肺癌。

entries.example: Like any company, we've got to look ahead and plan for the future.
entries.translation: 和其他公司一样，我们得向前看，规划好未来。

entries.example: Guilt about the accident was eating at him day and night.
entries.translation: 对那场事故的愧疚日夜折磨着他。

entries.example: As there was no bus, I had no choice but to walk.
entries.translation: 因为没有公交车，我只得走路。

entries.example: She's really upset right now, so just let her be.
entries.translation: 她现在非常难过，就别打扰她了。

entries.example: None of us thought he was to blame for the accident.
entries.translation: 我们都不认为他该为这起事故负责。

entries.example: Have you ever been stuck in an elevator?
entries.translation: 你曾经被困在电梯里过吗？

entries.example: To my horror, the man took a gun out of his pocket.
entries.translation: 令我惊恐的是，那名男子从口袋里掏出了一把枪。

entries.example: I thought I told you to stay away from my computer.
entries.translation: 我想我跟你说过离我的电脑远一点。

entries.example: He is known as a great poet.
entries.translation: 他作为一位伟大的诗人而闻名。

entries.example: I couldn't make her out at all.
entries.translation: 我完全弄不懂她。

entries.example: They say you shouldn't take rumors seriously, but that's easier said than done.
entries.translation: 人们常说不要轻信谣言，但说起来容易做起来难。

entries.example: I suggest you turn around and go back home.
entries.translation: 我建议你转过身回家去。

entries.example: Don't forget that good jobs are very hard to come by these days.
entries.translation: 别忘了，这年头好工作很难找。

entries.example: While in England, I often referred to the guidebook for details of my journey.
entries.translation: 在英国的时候，我常常翻阅旅游指南，查询旅途中的细节。

entries.example: Water turns into steam when it is boiled.
entries.translation: 水烧开后就会变成蒸汽。

entries.example: I'll let you know as soon as I am through with the report.
entries.translation: 报告一写完我就告诉你。

entries.example: He cared for his mother after his father died.
entries.translation: 父亲去世后，他就照顾起母亲来。

entries.example: He is concerned about his father's illness.
entries.translation: 他担心父亲的病。

entries.example: She went over the list to see if her name was there.
entries.translation: 她把名单仔细看了一遍，看自己的名字在不在上面。

entries.example: You've made excellent progress this term; keep up the good work.
entries.translation: 这学期你进步很大，继续保持。

entries.example: Is that true, or did you make the whole thing up?
entries.translation: 那是真的，还是整件事都是你编的？

entries.example: He is going to run for mayor.
entries.translation: 他打算竞选市长。

entries.example: A burglar broke into my house while I was away on a trip.
entries.translation: 一个入室盗窃者趁我去旅游的时候闯入了我家。

entries.example: As a consequence, additional tests must be carried out to ensure complete security.
entries.translation: 因此，必须进行额外的测试以确保完整的安全性。

entries.example: I followed the recipe carefully, but I still didn't get the cake right.
entries.translation: 我仔细按照食谱做，但蛋糕还是没做成功。

entries.example: I also hope for sunny weather at the weekend.
entries.translation: 我也希望周末是晴天。

entries.example: Please turn your homework in before you leave the classroom.
entries.translation: 请在离开教室前交上你的作业。

entries.example: He accused me of having stolen his watch.
entries.translation: 他指控我偷了他的手表。

entries.example: He lost his balance and fell off his bicycle.
entries.translation: 他失去了平衡，从自行车上摔了下来。

entries.example: I didn't mean to keep it secret.
entries.translation: 我不是有意要保密的。

entries.example: They are making for the forest.
entries.translation: 他们正向森林走去。

entries.example: Have you made up your mind where to go for the holidays?
entries.translation: 你想好假期去哪儿了吗？

entries.example: When he finished speaking, he stood up and walked away.
entries.translation: 他说完就站起来走了。

entries.example: The price of rice has come down.
entries.translation: 米价下跌了。

entries.example: I hate the English language and everything related to it.
entries.translation: 我讨厌英语以及一切跟它有关的东西。

entries.example: They waved good-bye to their parents as the train pulled out.
entries.translation: 火车开动时，他们向父母挥手道别。

entries.example: I have to take the book back to the library today.
entries.translation: 我今天必须把书还给图书馆。

entries.example: My car broke down this morning and won't be repaired until Friday.
entries.translation: 我的车今天早上坏了，星期五才能修好。

entries.example: She opened all the windows to let the smoke out.
entries.translation: 她打开所有窗户，把烟放出去。

entries.example: We don't have a name for the project yet, but we'll think something up soon.
entries.translation: 我们的项目还没有名字，不过很快就会想出一个。

entries.example: I finally talked her into lending me the book.
entries.translation: 我终于说服她把书借给我。

entries.example: After the robbery, his own brother turned him in to the police.
entries.translation: 抢劫案发生后，他的亲弟弟向警方告发了他。

entries.example: The man answers to the description in the newspaper.
entries.translation: 那个男人和报纸上描述的一模一样。

entries.example: My wife asked me to throw this old hat away.
entries.translation: 我妻子让我把这顶旧帽子扔掉。

entries.example: How did you get to know each other?
entries.translation: 你们是怎么认识的？

entries.example: The air we breathe consists of oxygen and nitrogen.
entries.translation: 我们呼吸的空气由氧气和氮气组成。

entries.example: The doctor will look in later to see how you are doing.
entries.translation: 医生晚些时候会来看看你的情况。

entries.example: It was dark and I couldn't make out the license plate number.
entries.translation: 天很黑，我看不清车牌号码。

entries.example: My father participated in a cooking contest and came in first.
entries.translation: 我爸爸参加了烹饪比赛，得了第一名。

entries.example: When he retired, his son took over the business.
entries.translation: 他退休的时候，儿子接手了生意。

entries.example: When the company refused to increase their wages, they walked out.
entries.translation: 当公司拒绝给他们加薪时，他们罢工了。

entries.translation: 昨天闹钟没响，库尔特也就没醒过来。

entries.example: Just because a certain book does not interest readers does not mean that the fault lies in the book.
entries.translation: 不是因为读者对某本书不感兴趣，这本书就肯定有问题。

entries.example: He's moving in with his girlfriend.
entries.translation: 他要搬去和女朋友一起住了。

entries.example: I hate it when my clothes smell of smoke.
entries.translation: 我讨厌我的衣服上有烟味。

entries.example: All you have to do is take advantage of this rare opportunity.
entries.translation: 你所要做的便是好好把握这千载难逢的机会。

entries.example: A fire broke out last night and three houses were burnt down.
entries.translation: 昨晚发生了一场火灾，三栋房屋被烧毁了。

entries.example: Few people are aware of how much water they use each day.
entries.translation: 很少有人意识到自己每天用了多少水。

entries.example: A dangerous criminal escaped from prison.
entries.translation: 一名危险的罪犯从监狱里逃了出来。

entries.example: She read the letter and then handed it on to her brother.
entries.translation: 她读完信后，又把它转交给了她哥哥。

entries.example: The mother was reluctant to leave her children alone.
entries.translation: 那位母亲不愿意把孩子们单独留在家里。

entries.example: A bus driver is responsible for the safety of the passengers.
entries.translation: 公交车司机要对乘客的安全负责。

entries.example: You should know better than to ask a lady her age.
entries.translation: 你应该明白不该问女士的年龄。

entries.example: He walked as fast as he could to catch up with her.
entries.translation: 为了赶上她，他尽可能快地走。

entries.example: Suddenly the lion came at his trainer.
entries.translation: 狮子突然向训练员扑了过去。

entries.translation: 约翰大约用了两周时间才康复。

entries.example: It is up to you to decide whether we will go there or not.
entries.translation: 该由你来决定我们去不去那儿。

entries.example: He just looked on and didn't stop the quarrel.
entries.translation: 他只是在一旁看着，没有去阻止争吵。

entries.example: In point of fact, she had nothing to do with the scandal.
entries.translation: 事实上，她和这桩丑闻没有任何关系。

entries.example: I had a hard time trying to persuade him to cancel the trip.
entries.translation: 说服他取消这次旅行真是件苦差事。

entries.example: Does the mid-autumn festival fall on Monday this year?
entries.translation: 今年中秋节是星期一吗？

entries.example: Tell the children to stay out of the kitchen.
entries.translation: 告诉孩子们别进厨房。

entries.example: It took me a few weeks to break in my new hiking boots.
entries.translation: 我花了几周时间才把新登山靴穿得合脚。

entries.example: His lie got him into trouble when his boss discovered the truth.
entries.translation: 当老板发现真相时，他的谎言让他陷入了麻烦。

entries.example: The salesman talked my parents into buying a set of encyclopedias.
entries.translation: 推销员说服我父母买了一套百科全书。

entries.example: You should think it over for a moment.
entries.translation: 你应该好好考虑一下。

entries.translation: 他靠在当地市场卖新鲜蔬菜为生。

entries.example: We usually eat in on weekdays and go out on weekends.
entries.translation: 工作日我们通常在家吃饭，周末出去吃。

entries.example: Looking back at 2010, I think I wasted too much time.
entries.translation: 回顾2010年，我觉得自己浪费了太多时间。

entries.example: If you buy the laptop, they'll throw a carrying case in for free.
entries.translation: 如果你买这台笔记本电脑，他们会免费赠送一个便携包。

entries.example: His parents are moving back to their home town.
entries.translation: 他父母正搬回老家。

entries.example: I'll stop by the post office on the way home.
entries.translation: 我会在回家的路上顺便去趟邮局。

entries.translation: 上个月，我们二十岁的女儿生了一个女孩。

entries.example: I will stand by you whatever happens.
entries.translation: 不论发生什么事，我都会支持你。

entries.example: You're bleeding everywhere; I'll help you up.
entries.translation: 你到处都在流血，我扶你起来吧。

entries.translation: 他在花园里砍倒了一棵树。

entries.example: Someone locked me in the room.
entries.translation: 有人把我锁在房间里了。

entries.example: The car won't start because the battery has run down.
entries.translation: 车发动不了，因为电池没电了。

entries.translation: 她听到这个消息后吓坏了。

entries.example: Does it matter to you how much it costs?
entries.translation: 它花多少钱对你来说重要吗？

entries.example: She always dresses in black.
entries.translation: 她总是穿黑色的衣服。

entries.example: Computers are capable of doing extremely complicated work.
entries.translation: 计算机能够做极其复杂的工作。

entries.example: All the furniture was covered with dust.
entries.translation: 所有家具上都布满了灰尘。

entries.example: I had to study hard to keep up with the other students.
entries.translation: 我必须努力学习，才能跟上其他同学。

entries.example: They are engaged in cancer research.
entries.translation: 他们从事癌症研究工作。

entries.example: You're just running away from life's problems.
entries.translation: 你只是在逃避生活中的问题。

entries.example: I still dream about the old house where I grew up.
entries.translation: 我仍然会梦见我长大的那座老房子。

entries.example: I can't put up with that noise any longer.
entries.translation: 我再也无法忍受那噪音了。

entries.example: My uncle had me act as a translator.
entries.translation: 我叔叔让我担任翻译。

entries.example: Reading a book can be compared to making a journey.
entries.translation: 阅读一本书可以比作一次旅行。

entries.example: I can usually tell when someone is hiding something from me.
entries.translation: 我通常能看出一个人是不是在瞒着我什么事情。

entries.example: They were almost run over by a truck.
entries.translation: 他们差点被一辆卡车碾过。

entries.example: They decided to build in some shelves along the living room wall.
entries.translation: 他们决定在客厅墙边嵌入一些架子。

entries.example: My father insisted on our waiting for the train.
entries.translation: 我父亲坚持要我们等火车。

entries.example: Best case scenario, you get kicked out of the house.
entries.translation: 最好的情况是，你被赶出这所房子。

entries.example: The game ended in a draw, and the final score was 2-2.
entries.translation: 比赛以平局结束，最终比分是2比2。

entries.example: She seems to have something against me for no clear reason.
entries.translation: 她似乎无缘无故对我有意见。

entries.example: Two men are checking on what's wrong with the car.
entries.translation: 两个男人正在查看汽车出了什么故障。

entries.lemma: have no choice but to do something
entries.surface: had no choice but to walk
entries.example: As there was no bus, I had no choice but to walk.
entries.translation: 因为没有公交车，我只得走路。

entries.example: I wonder if you don't get tired of doing the same thing every day.
entries.translation: 我想知道，你每天做同样的事情会不会觉得厌倦？

entries.example: It looks as if it is going to rain.
entries.translation: 天看起来要下雨了。

entries.example: I think you had better stick to your present job.
entries.translation: 我觉得你最好继续做现在的工作。

entries.example: I have never come across such a stubborn person.
entries.translation: 我从没碰到过这么倔的人。

entries.example: No sooner had the child seen his mother than he burst into tears.
entries.translation: 孩子一见到母亲就哭了起来。

entries.example: Hey man, take it easy. I'm just messing with you.
entries.translation: 嘿，老兄，放松点。我只是跟你开个玩笑。

entries.example: We should classify them before throwing them out.
entries.translation: 我们应该先把它们分类，再扔掉。

entries.translation: 经理把那个捣乱的人赶出了餐厅。

entries.example: What should I do if a customer tries to flirt with me?
entries.translation: 要是顾客想跟我调情，我该怎么办？

entries.translation: 收音机太响了。你不能把音量调低一点吗？

entries.translation: 你只是搞砸了一次，不必为此苦恼不已。

entries.translation: 差不多过了两周，约翰才从病中恢复过来。

entries.translation: 周三你能载我去办公室吗？

entries.translation: 我觉得有点恶心，但吐不出来。

entries.example: Sorry, I was taking a nap and didn't hear you ring the doorbell.
entries.translation: 对不起，我在睡午觉，没听到你按门铃。

entries.example: This technology will open up a whole new avenue of research.
entries.translation: 这项技术将开辟一个全新的研究领域。

entries.example: The man passed by without so much as glancing at her.
entries.translation: 那人连瞧也不瞧她一眼就走过了。

entries.example: Go and help wash up at the sink!
entries.translation: 去水槽那儿帮忙洗碗吧！

entries.example: This rule doesn't apply to every case.
entries.translation: 这条规则并非适用于所有情况。

entries.example: I went without food for a week.
entries.translation: 我一个星期没吃东西。

entries.example: She has a crush on the boy next door.
entries.translation: 她暗恋隔壁的男孩。

entries.example: Americans, in general, don't like to dress up.
entries.translation: 总的来说，美国人不喜欢盛装打扮。

entries.example: I can not do without this dictionary even for a single day.
entries.translation: 我一天也离不开这本字典。

entries.example: The president called on the people to unite in fighting poverty and disease.
entries.translation: 总统呼吁人民团结起来抗击贫困和疾病。

entries.example: We were cut off while talking on the telephone.

entries.translation: 小心！地板还是湿的，你可能会滑倒。

entries.translation: 我想当然地认为他会信守诺言。

entries.translation: 我在公园散步时偶然遇到了一位老朋友。

entries.translation: 他反对被当作小孩对待。

entries.translation: 她的朋友们承诺帮助她度过这段困难时期。

entries.translation: 有时候，我们应该退一步想一想。

entries.translation: 把果酱从最上层的架子上拿下来。

entries.translation: 在百货商店里，一位非常亲切的年轻女子接待了我。

entries.translation: 我试着开门，结果门把手掉了下来。

entries.translation: 男孩伸手又拿了一块蛋糕。

entries.translation: 你到现在都在干些什么呀？！

entries.translation: 有那么一会儿，他想着去追那个人。

entries.translation: 我一打开大门，那只狗就朝我追来。

entries.translation: 你不妨把一切都告诉我。

entries.translation: 他们结婚一年后就分手了。

entries.translation: 我是个有抱负的人——非常清楚自己追求的是什么。

entries.translation: 你的话与我们正在谈论的话题有什么关系？

entries.translation: 如果你不想一个人待着，我可以陪你。

entries.translation: 他没有胆量拒绝我的计划。

entries.translation: 但我会始终就我们面临的挑战对你坦诚相待。

entries.translation: 汽车撞上护栏，滚下了山坡。

entries.translation: 注意了！服务器半夜要停机。

entries.translation: 这位歌手有一副好嗓子，但我认为他不会受到年轻人的喜爱。

entries.translation: 我在攒钱买一辆新车。

entries.translation: 你不必大声喊，我能听见。

entries.translation: 即使是被逼到角落的兔子也会反击。

entries.translation: 十三岁生日过后没几天，汤尼也退学了。

entries.translation: 公司非常信任你的能力。

entries.translation: 我长大后想当一名医生。

entries.translation: 我下班回家的路上被一群流氓痛打了一顿。

entries.translation: 我们应该在哪里处理这些废弃物？

entries.translation: 雨后，太阳从云层中露了出来。

entries.translation: 请原谅我这么早给你打电话。

entries.translation: 医生该做的是拯救生命，与死亡抗争。

entries.translation: 她正和她的老板有婚外情。

entries.translation: 那间旧屋只有一张床，所以我们轮流睡在上面。

entries.translation: 学校对殴打同学的学生实行零容忍政策。

entries.translation: 好几座房屋被大洪水冲走了。

entries.translation: 你做错事时必须立刻道歉。

entries.translation: 他看到我时把目光移开了，就像我们是陌生人一样。

entries.translation: 运动员们闲坐着打发时间，等待比赛开始。

entries.translation: 你到附近时，随时可以进来喝杯咖啡。

entries.translation: 别担心我的狗，它不会伤害你的。

entries.translation: 学习一门外语的一个方法就是与该语言的母语者交流。

entries.translation: 你又在欺负比你弱小的人了！

entries.translation: 孩子们穿着他们最好的衣服去参加婚礼。

entries.translation: 请耐心听我把故事讲完。

entries.translation: 我们和很多国家有生意往来。

entries.translation: 这几天我脑子里的事情太多了。

entries.translation: 让我们抛开一切，从零开始重新来过。

entries.translation: 讨论变得激烈时，她插话提出了一个冷静的建议。

entries.translation: 别把手肘放在桌子上。

entries.translation: 你是想耍我吗？

entries.translation: 正如我所料，承包商今天又回来了，恳求再宽限一些时间。

entries.translation: 你的行为使全班蒙羞。

entries.translation: 她用绳子把包裹紧紧绑好了。

entries.translation: 那个肇事逃逸的司机在父亲陪同下，第二天前来投案自首。

entries.translation: 当圣诞节来临时，我通常会收到许多礼物。

entries.translation: 组织者为所有想参加这次旅行的人安排了额外的巴士。

entries.translation: 离开时别忘了锁门。

entries.translation: 我成功说服了她，我们去约会了。

entries.translation: 我一直在思考你对我说的话。

entries.translation: 我非常乐意和你们乐团一起唱歌。

entries.translation: 我们的收入不多，但还能勉强过活。

entries.translation: 让我捎你到车站吧。

entries.translation: 她本应该保持沉默的。

entries.translation: 每次见到我，他都要吹嘘一番自己的车。

entries.translation: 我骑上自行车去追那个小偷。

entries.translation: 如今很难做到收支相抵。

entries.translation: 他利用这个机会来提高自己的英语水平。

entries.translation: 一个劫匪抢走了他所有的钱。

entries.translation: 她威胁要放火烧我们的房子。

entries.translation: 当两名球员之间的争吵失控时，教练介入让所有人冷静下来。

entries.translation: 哈里因为手臂骨折不得不退出比赛。

entries.translation: 哪个更重要，你的事业还是家庭？

entries.translation: 这辆车陷在泥里了。

entries.example: It was only a joke, but I think you went too far this time.
entries.translation: 这只是个玩笑，但我觉得你这次太过分了。

entries.translation: 不要只因为他穷就看不起他。

entries.example: We should pass on our culture to the next generation.
entries.translation: 我们应当把文化传承给下一代。

entries.translation: 她按照老师的建议申请了那份工作。

entries.translation: 日本公司已经建立了品质方面的信誉。

entries.translation: 她把食谱从杂志上剪下来，放进了笔记本里。

entries.translation: 无论如何，我尽了自己的责任。

entries.translation: 由于所载物品太重，箱子散架了。

entries.translation: 苍蝇和蚊子干扰了他的冥想。

entries.translation: 她在熙熙攘攘的人群中看不见她的朋友了。

entries.translation: 她埋头看书，没听到电话响。

entries.translation: 日落时分老城的美景让我深受触动。

entries.translation: 我一确定就给你打电话。

entries.translation: 要孩子满足父母的期望总是很难的。

entries.translation: 汤姆卷起裤管，露出鲜红的袜子。

entries.translation: 坚持下来，你就能成功。

entries.translation: 下个月开始我不订报纸了。

entries.translation: 也许你不知道，但没有人能取代你的位置。

entries.translation: 汤姆，我们支持你。

entries.translation: 他们将在两天内拆除这栋旧建筑。

entries.translation: 他们显然嫉妒他的财富和地位。

entries.translation: 我太太的兼职工作赚了一些额外的钱。

entries.translation: 这家慈善机构依靠志愿者维持食品银行的运转。

entries.translation: 他叫男孩们排好队。

entries.translation: 过马路时要当心汽车。

entries.translation: 我认为大多数人现在比以前过得好。

entries.translation: 我出城度假了。

entries.translation: 不要把皮肤长时间暴露在阳光里。

entries.translation: 他疲劳过度，又睡眠不足，最后便病倒了。

entries.translation: 我们卷入了一场交通事故。

entries.translation: 不要把彗星和小行星搞混了。

entries.translation: 他去欧洲旅行了。

entries.translation: 你离开前务必确保门已经锁好。

entries.translation: 科技的进步给我们的生活带来了巨大的转变。

entries.translation: 她很擅长转换话题。

entries.translation: 我凝望大海好几个小时。

entries.translation: 救援人员将为地震受灾者分发物资。

entries.translation: 告诉他别多管闲事。

entries.translation: 他把大部分业余时间都用来帮助当地社区。

entries.translation: 那个男孩十二岁时被音乐学校开除了。

entries.translation: 皮肤不应该长时间暴露在阳光下。

entries.translation: 她躲在门后，屏住了呼吸。

entries.translation: 我上大学时，每当需要用钱，父母总能及时接济我。

entries.translation: 他总是抱怨自己的房间太小。

entries.translation: 公司去年决定废除几条过时的规定。

entries.translation: 不言而喻，金钱买不到幸福。

entries.translation: 这个家庭太穷了，无力偿还债务。

entries.translation: 你必须立刻向警方报告。

entries.translation: 那一刻，时间仿佛静止了。

entries.translation: 无论如何，我们必须先完成这一章，才能开始下一章。

entries.translation: 她整夜照顾母亲。

entries.translation: 黑客擅长绕过电脑安全措施。

entries.translation: 她太纵容孩子们随心所欲了。

entries.translation: 你将从一次出国旅行中受益。

entries.translation: 这个季节食物很容易变坏。

entries.translation: 许多士兵与配偶吻别。

entries.translation: 大多数学生同意这个建议，并列出了支持它的理由。

entries.translation: 所有票在一个小时内就卖完了。

entries.translation: 勇气是个奇怪的东西：人永远无法对它有把握。

entries.translation: 英式英语和美式英语在许多方面不同。

entries.translation: 许多高中生泡在书店里看漫画。

entries.translation: 你太依赖父母了，必须更加独立。

entries.translation: 研究人员认为这种疾病与大城市的空气污染有关。

entries.translation: 如果天气允许，我明天去修剪草坪。

entries.translation: 伤者被从现场运走了。

entries.translation: 我走到她面前，鞠了一躬，亲吻了她的手。

entries.translation: 我不明白詹姆斯为什么总是挑剔他的妻子。

entries.translation: 她害怕黑暗。
